name: Remote trace (for developers)
description: For developers: sends annai's trace, as the Trace screen shows it, to a server you run, while you watch. It sends nothing until you give it a server and a token and turn Send on. Never keys.

server.title: Server address
server.description: Where annai sends its trace: a server you run, such as annai's scripts/trace-sink.mjs. https://…, or http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.

token.title: Token
token.description: The server's token. annai sends it as Authorization: Bearer, and keeps it with your keys, never in a file.

location.title: Send location points
location.description: Also send the location points annai records while GPS is on, about one a second on a drive. Off, other entries can still name a place, as the Trace shows them: a weather request's address, a tool's input.

send.title: Send
send.description: On, what the Trace records from now on goes to the server within a few seconds: what you write, what Shiori says, her tools, requests and errors. Keys are blanked, and stored content (photos, long texts) stays here. Off stops it at once.

device.title: Device id
device.description: Sent with each batch, so the server can tell this device from another. annai makes one at the first send; you may give it a name of your own.
